_note: Scaffold of catdad/canvas-confetti as read 2026-10-14 via gh + npm + README. Nothing installed.
description: performant confetti animation in the browser

api.confetti(options): fire once on a shared full-page canvas; returns Promise (or null if unsupported)
api.confetti.create(canvas, {resize, useWork: bind to your own canvas; useWorker moves rendering to an OffscreenCanvas worker and transfers canvas control
api.confetti.shapeFromPath({path, matrix?}): custom vector shape from an SVG path

surfaces: frontend/ (React; needs 'use client', fire from effect/handler)
theme (vanilla; single ~92 KB unpacked file, no bundler needed, would be vendored self-hosted)
brand_constraints: Colours must come from brand tokens (#B76E79 rose gold, #D4AF37 gold, #C0C0C0 silver, #DC143C crimson, #0A0A0A); never default rainbow
Set disableForReducedMotion: true (also an accessibility requirement)
Founder voice: garment is the protagonist, no urgency timers; confetti must not read as a promotion gimmick. Founder call before any storefront use
Visual refs are streetwear (Kith, Oaklandish, Culture Kings, FoG, Palm Angels), not novelty; a luxury-restrained particle burst is the bar
skyyrose_fit.perf: canvas particle sim; useWorker keeps main thread free; no WebGL context, so no conflict with three.js
